messages:
aj: starting a staged rollout: int4-nf4-small-2 -> 7% traffic, 30m smoke. watching QA signals :eyes:
deploy-bot: triggered rollout int4-nf4-small-2 @ 7% to shard set 'stable-bridge'
aj: quick checklist: smoke evals running, shadow compare on longform, KV cache hit monitored
sachin: uploaded eval set 'paraphrase-longform-2026' and baselines. embedding-sim and hallucination counters enabled
maria: perf note: p50 ~ 18ms, p99 baseline was 92ms. initial quant p99 seen 104ms (+12ms). token cost estimate -28%
eva: ran A/B at 3% for 15m: short-form metrics ok, long-form summary ROUGE-L dropped 0.9 absolute (from 27.3 -> 26.4)
leo: that's small but consistent on edge cases. how many long-form samples?
eva: ~420 long-form pairs so far, variance ~0.6
aj: set auto-fallback thresholds: hallucination_rate_delta > 1.0% absolute OR embed_sim_drop > 0.025 OR p99_latency_increase > 60ms
sachin: patch to rollout controller ready. policy snippet:
```
fallback_rules:
  - name: hallucination_absolute
    comparator: absolute_delta
    metric: hallucination_rate
    threshold: 0.01
  - name: embed_sim_relative
    comparator: absolute_delta
    metric: embed_similarity
    threshold: 0.025
  - name: p99_latency
    comparator: absolute_delta
    metric: latency_p99_ms
    threshold: 60
```
aj: also add a soft-stop: if quality drift > 0.5% but sample count < 1000, switch to shadow-only for another 2h
maria: telemetry set to sample token-level traces for failing cases. forwarded to /datasets/onboard/int4-fails for offline eval
eva: eval-bot: running shadow-compare job now. expected finish ~20m
eva: quick numbers from shadow compare (first 200 samples):
- embed_sim mean: baseline 0.873 -> quant 0.848 (delta 0.025)
- hallucination_rate: baseline 1.7% -> quant 2.9% (delta 1.2%)
- avg response tokens: baseline 142 -> quant 140
- p99 latency: baseline 92ms -> quant 106ms
leo: hallucination_delta 1.2% breaches our 1.0% rule. should trigger fallback
sachin: controller log shows detect: "hallucination_absolute breach at 2026-04-12T15:16:08Z, delta=0.012"
deploy-bot: initiating rollback to int8-nf4-small-1 per policy
aj: good. can we capture the failing prompts for targeted eval and A/B tweaks?
maria: yes exporting top-200 highest-delta examples to /datasets/onboard/int4-fails/top200.jsonl
eva: recommend a short patch: adjust quant params for attention scaling and re-run smoke in shadow for 4h before re-try
leo: also consider lowering traffic next time: start at 1% for 1h, then 5% for 2h, then 10% if stable
aj: agreed. lessons: 1) keep shadow compare early 2) auto-fallback thresholds saved us 3) need more long-form samples in preflight
sachin: I will add a new preflight job that draws 2k longform samples and runs quick embed/halluc checks before staging
eva: filing follow-up ticket in eng-ml board: "int4 onboarding: increase longform preflight + attention scaling patch"
aj: thanks team. closing this thread once artifacts uploaded. :white_check_mark:
